# Identity vocabulary
Owner: Identity domain team. Accepted revision: v3.
Account: a person's identity across projects.
Membership: the relationship between an Account and one Project.
Guest: a Membership role with an expiry date. One Account can be a guest in multiple projects.
Suspension: an Account-wide restriction.
